_meta.description: Product-intent confirmation record. For each submitted link: the intended ASIN and the official listing URL the site publishes, the date and source of that confirmation, and the observed redirect target kept in its own separate field. The two fields are never merged. Amazon defines the ASIN as the checkable product identifier (S-ASIN); the short-link path code is not an ASIN (F-67).
_meta.tracking_id_source: Supplied by the owner in the brief (2026-11-19) and the preceding brief (2026-11-17). Format check: Amazon's help page (S-TAG, read 2026-11-17) states Amazon's software adds '-20' to Store IDs and a US Store ID ends in -20. Registration and activity of this ID are confirmable only inside Associates Central (F-57).
_meta.method: Each owner-submitted short link was fetched with redirects followed; the final listing URL and page title were read; the intended ASIN is the ASIN of that official listing. Observed redirects are stored as dated raw observations in observed_redirect_history and are never copied into intended_asin fields without a listing read. Not verified anywhere: Associates reporting, commission categories, tag attribution (F-57, F-58).
_meta.short_link_status_note: The supplied short links are recorded verbatim and are not judged valid or invalid — their compliance status is unresolved (Zone3 FLG-003). The site publishes the tagged Special Links below as its outbound product hrefs (decisions D-01/D-14, carried; D-P06), per Participation Requirements 2(b) and 6(v)-(w): final destination URL with the tag as a parameter, no shortener.
